verdict: Only with strong operations. Little Box from Guwahati pitched fast fashion on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from five sharks. It proved a brand from the North-East can compete nationally, but fast fashion means frequent launches, tight stock control and a lot of ad spend.
angle: Fast fashion needs new designs every week and quick reorders of what sells. The winners use data to decide quickly and keep batches small. Against Zudio, marketplace labels and Shein, a small brand needs a clear style and a loyal Instagram following.
